# Acuity Scheduling

Generated from [tokens.json](tokens.json) and [README.md](README.md) by the design-systems catalog tool. Do not edit this file: change the tokens through the package's builders, then run `make design-md` at the repository root.

It follows the DESIGN.md spec, version alpha. That format has no themes, no per-value provenance and only px, em and rem units, so this file holds the `light` theme alone with every alias resolved. [tokens.json](tokens.json) is the source of truth: it records where each value was read, and keeps the 2 tokens from these groups that DESIGN.md cannot hold (gradients, shadows, percentages, durations and other non-colour or non-px values).

## Overview

Good for: Booking-software marketing pages: pastel hero gradients, Clarkson Serif headlines in navy #283849, 12px-radius ink buttons, cream and lavender cards, a Squarespace account gate with square black-ruled OAuth rows.

Captured 2026-11-10, signed out (every captured surface is public); the Squarespace account gate was measured and state-forced, never submitted. Themes: light.

A token set and component reference for Acuity Scheduling's public marketing site, for building a booking-software marketing page or account-entry screen in the style of Squarespace's scheduling product. It was read from acuityscheduling.com on 2026-11-09 and 2026-11-10, signed out, in headless Chromium at 1440 wide and 390 wide: the home page, pricing, how-it-works, features, solutions, an industry page (Beauty), about and learn, plus the two public auth surfaces the site hands off to — Squarespace's "Create your account" gate at /get-started and the sign-in card at secure.acuityscheduling.com. The look is warm and soft: a pastel hero gradient, Clarkson Serif headlines in navy `#283849`, 12px-radius ink buttons, and pastel card fills on white.

The scheduling product itself sits behind the Squarespace account and was never entered; this package is the marketing and account-entry surface only. Nothing was signed into, bought, downloaded or submitted, and the consent SDKs were aborted at request level before any banner could mount.

### Fonts (from README.md)

| Family | Faces served | Used for |
|---|---|---|
| Clarkson | 400, 500 | Everything working: nav, buttons, fields, body copy, the mobile menu. Squarespace's brand sans, served from `/font/Clarkson-*.woff2` |
| Clarkson Serif | 300, 400, 500 | Display headlines only, at 500: hero 40/48 (48/48 on the pricing band), plan names 32/40, card titles 24/28 |
| Recoleta | 300, 400, 500 | Fallback inside the serif stacks, and the hero gradient block's alternate face |

Both families are Squarespace's property (served from the site's own `/font/` paths), so the style guide previews in Public Sans and Fraunces and no font file is committed. The family names and weights in the tokens are the real measured ones.

### The screen to get right (from README.md)

The home page is the screen to get right. An 80px white bar carries the acuity:scheduling wordmark, five Clarkson nav items and the ink Get-started pill. Below, a pastel gradient hero centres a 40/48 Clarkson Serif headline in navy over two 56px ghost CTAs on 1px ink rules. Cream industry cards float on paired soft shadows, a grey feature card holds another ink button, the lavender testimonial slides auto-play under a dotted indicator, and the page closes on a pale-blue band: a navy support card with a serif headline, then a tall 72px ink CTA, then the white footer. Everything the capture could not reach is listed under Gaps in [components.md](components.md#gaps).

## Do's and Don'ts

- Do take values from [tokens.json](tokens.json) when you need another theme, a value's source, or a token this file leaves out.
- Do read [README.md](README.md) before relying on a value; it says what is known to be wrong.
- Don't read colours off the screenshots; they are 256-colour PNGs.
- Don't copy the product's logo, icons, illustrations or brand colours into something that ships. Borrow structure and proportions.
- Don't edit this file; it is regenerated from the tokens.

### What to distrust (from README.md)

- **Readings past a masked bot signal.** The committed screenshots and readings were taken with `navigator.webdriver` masked, the flag bot checks read to spot automation. The capture scripts no longer mask it (not run since), so a recapture may record a walled route as a boundary instead of a reading.
- **Screenshots are 256-colour PNGs.** The pastel hero gradient and photography band slightly; read exact colours from tokens.json or the raw files.
- **The home hero repaints per load.** Nine `--c1/--c2/--c3` gradient variants rotate (raw/css-vars.json); the tokens record the variant live during the capture, and the sampled pixels differ from the declared stops because the gradient sits under a white ::after wash.
- **The pricing hero's dark band is a photograph** (`pricing-background.webp`), not a flat fill — its pixels (~#334e53 teal) are image content, not a palette value.
- **`social-link`'s and the wordmark's `rgb(0, 0, 238)` and `rgb(255, 0, 0)` are UA defaults**: those anchors carry no `color` of their own, so rest shows the browser's link blue and a forced `:active` shows its red. Measurement artifacts, not design values.
- **The two ink buttons move in opposite directions on hover**: the header pill lightens to `#3e5772`, the plan button darkens to `#1e2d3a`. Both are measured, verified on the crop pairs.
- **`plan-card` itself paints transparent**: the white hairline-bordered card is its `.plan-wrapper` sibling (see its Child layers).
- **The gate dialog's `Times` font reading** is the browser default on a container that sets no family; its children all measure Clarkson.
- **The testimonial carousel auto-plays**, so two captures of the same section can differ in the slide shown; `testimonial-card` is measured on its first slide.

### Do and don't (from README.md)

1. **Do let one ink do all the work.** `#283849` is the only action colour: every primary button, the serif headlines, the ghost CTAs' 1px rules, the FAQ band and the support card. There is no bright accent anywhere. See [home-light-default](screenshots/home-light-default.png), [pricing-light-default](screenshots/pricing-light-default.png) and [nav-cta-default](components/crops/nav-cta-default.png).
2. **Do keep the 12px corner.** Buttons, plan cards and CTAs share the 12px radius; cards step to 16px, panels and the testimonial to 22–24px, and the pricing toggle is a full pill. The gate's square black-ruled rows are the exception — they belong to Squarespace's shared auth surface. See [plan-cta-default](components/crops/plan-cta-default.png) and [plan-card-default](components/crops/plan-card-default.png).
3. **Do pair Clarkson Serif headlines with Clarkson UI.** Serif at 500 sets hero, plan and card headlines; the sans sets everything else at 14/22 or 16/22, mostly regular. The only caps are the gate's 12px uppercase labels tracked 0.5px. See [hero-title-default](components/crops/hero-title-default.png) and [plan-name-default](components/crops/plan-name-default.png).
4. **Don't give links a link colour.** Marketing links are plain text that fades to 50% on hover (nav) or underlines (footer); the only "blue" anywhere is Chromium's own `#005fcc` focus ring. See [nav-link-hover](components/crops/nav-link-hover.png) and [footer-link-hover](components/crops/footer-link-hover.png).
5. **Don't invent fills for hover.** Hovers are opacity fades, the two measured ink steps, or a light `#f2f2f2` row wash — never a new colour. See [dropdown-item-hover](components/crops/dropdown-item-hover.png) and [nav-cta-hover](components/crops/nav-cta-hover.png).
6. **Do keep the three focus rings.** Links and accordions take the browser's 1px `#005fcc` auto ring, the mobile menu draws `#e59700` amber, and the gate's buttons paint a 2px-white/4px-black double box-shadow ring — keep all three rather than unifying them. See [plan-cta-focus-visible](components/crops/plan-cta-focus-visible.png), [m-menu-link-focus-visible](components/crops/m-menu-link-focus-visible.png) and [oauth-google-focus-visible](components/crops/oauth-google-focus-visible.png).
